notes: Go only. Two pixel-art games, PiG Runner (/runner, /pig-runner) and Angry Pigs (/angry-pigs), moved from PiG Standard (Michael Kinsy, MIT). They draw the pig chosen with PiG's built-in /sprite (PiG 0.4.0 and later), so the Piglet bundles no login of its own. Run npm run stage before using its generated manifest under dist/staged.

Nothing starts by itself. The games register only their commands and no event handler (PIG_GAMES_MCP=1 adds a session_start handler for the opt-in agent server; /runner mcp on and /angry-pigs mcp on serve a game to an agent on 127.0.0.1 behind a random token, off by default). Both Packages (pig-runner, angry-pigs) also install on their own from a Pigpen checkout; each needs the pig-play sprite library beside it (../pig-play).

A Piglet Binary builds locally from the staged manifest with PIG_SOURCE_ROOT set to a git checkout of the PiG source. Signed Binaries for the five manifest targets are published as GitHub Release pig-games/v0.1.1 (built natively by the release workflow; pull one with pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/pig-games@0.1.1); the local runs in this repository are linux/amd64 only, and no platform is a support claim.
